items.title: Barclays (LSE:BARC) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim After Analyst Target Cuts

items.title: What Could A Senate Epstein Probe Mean For JPMorgan Chase (JPM)?
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) faces a planned Senate Democratic investigation into its historic banking ties with Jeffrey Epstein.
